newsitem.title: GERMANY: Mercedes 9 month sales up, to meet 1996 target.
newsitem.headline: Mercedes 9 month sales up, to meet 1996 target.

text.p: Mercedes-Benz AG said on Friday that unit car sales in the first nine months of the year rose sharply and the luxury-car maker was confident it would meet its 1996 target of achieving sales of 75 billion marks.

Unit worldwide car sales rose 13 percent from January to September to more than 481,000. In Germany alone, unit car sales during the same period rose 17 percent to nearly 202,000, Juergen Fahr, Mercedes car sales director, told reporters.
He added that Mercedes was confident of meeting its sales target for 1996. Fahr was speaking at the AAA car exhibition in Berlin.
